verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only covers migrating files/data via Migration Assistant onto a Mac and various continuity/system features; there is no evidence of macOS being installable in place of an existing OS on non-Apple hardware, which is the core of this switcher story. Missing for 10: any documentation of installing macOS on a PC/other machine replacing an existing OS, dual-boot/replace-install support, or hardware compatibility beyond Apple's own machines.
